title: Walk with Sam about the apiary

segments.content: So how many hives are you running this year?
segments.speaker: Sam Ortiz

segments.content: Five again. But I have stopped opening them every week. Rest is part of the work, for the bees and for me. A colony that is left alone spends its energy on the colony, not on repairing what I disturbed.
segments.speaker: Robin Vale

segments.content: That sounds like an excuse to be lazy.
segments.speaker: Sam Ortiz

segments.content: Maybe. But laziness and trust look the same from the outside. The difference is whether you have built the conditions first. I spend March getting the boxes right so I can leave them alone in May. Trust is something you prepare for.
segments.speaker: Robin Vale

segments.content: Exactly. Most of good care happens before anyone is watching. By the time there is a crisis, the useful decisions have already been made or missed.
segments.speaker: Robin Vale
